login.title: Sign in to NDISP
login.subtitle: Select how you'd like to explore the portal
login.personaHint: Choose a role to enter a hands-on demo workspace — every persona lands in its own portal experience.
login.specNote: NDISP role-based demo access — JWT claim simulation, 11-stage state machine and the reactive simulation engine. All data is illustrative for the Nalanda & Rajgir pilot.
login.role.citizen: Register complaints via a step-by-step wizard, track status and confirm resolution.
login.role.collector: District executive command center, SLA leaderboards and AI recommendations.
login.role.dm: District Magistrate approvals, directive tasking and proposal review.
login.role.adm: Delegated administrative oversight and sector grievance monitoring.
login.role.deptHead: Departmental resource planning, asset schemas and officer tasking.
login.role.deptOfficer: Manage assigned complaint queues, schedule inspections and resolve.
login.role.inspector: Mobile field inspection, site geo-tag validation and evidence upload.
login.role.engineer: Assistant / Executive engineer job execution and material logging.
login.role.supervisor: Field operations supervision and inspection report verification.
login.role.stateAdmin: State-level cross-district KPI comparison and radar analytics.

footer.tagline: A Spatial Decision Support System for district governance
landing.hero.subtitle: NDISP is the Government's GIS-driven Spatial Decision Support System that connects citizens, district administration and line departments — from facility discovery and grievance redressal to evidence-based infrastructure planning at national scale.
landing.hero.cmd.title: District Command
landing.services.title: Government services, one portal away
landing.services.subtitle: Everything a resident needs — built around the real needs of districts like Nalanda and Rajgir.
landing.services.locate.title: Locate Facilities
landing.services.locate.text: Search any hospital, school, water source or public asset across the district on an interactive GIS map.
landing.services.report.title: Report an Issue
landing.services.report.text: Geo-tag a complaint on any public asset with a photo and description in under two minutes.
landing.services.track.title: Track Grievances
landing.services.track.text: Follow SLA-driven status from submission to verified closure — with department updates at every step.
landing.services.schemes.title: Discover Schemes
landing.services.schemes.text: Find government schemes, check eligibility and follow application status at district level.
landing.services.reports.title: District Reports
landing.services.reports.text: Download public facility directories and KPI reports in PDF, Excel and CSV formats.
landing.services.gis.title: Explore District GIS
landing.services.gis.text: Layered infrastructure view — health, water, education, tourism, solar and district assets.
landing.sectors.title: Six line departments, one shared platform
landing.sectors.subtitle: A single data model and analytics engine power every sector — no silos, no duplicate computation.
landing.sectors.health.title: Health & Family Welfare
landing.sectors.health.text: Hospitals, PHCs, sub-centres, ambulances and vaccination coverage — accessibility & emergency reachability analysis.
landing.sectors.water.title: Water & Sanitation
landing.sectors.water.text: Pipelines, tanks, borewells and Jal Jeevan Mission connections with watershed and groundwater analytics.
landing.sectors.education.title: School Education
landing.sectors.education.text: Schools, colleges and Anganwadi centres with catchment, teacher deployment and digital classroom analytics.
landing.sectors.tourism.title: Tourism & Heritage
landing.sectors.tourism.text: Heritage sites, museums, circuits and visitor facilities — circuit planning with heritage-buffer geofences.
landing.sectors.solar.title: Solar & Renewables
landing.sectors.solar.text: Rooftop irradiance scoring and solar-farm site suitability for clean-energy planning.
landing.sectors.assets.title: District Assets
landing.sectors.assets.text: Roads, government buildings and public land — village asset inventory with condition mapping.
landing.how.title: From data to delivery in four phases
landing.how.subtitle: The Pan-India District Portal flow — ingestion, analytics, executive action and citizen visibility.
landing.how.ingest.title: Ingest
landing.how.ingest.text: Departments publish validated CSV data through a single ingestion contract. Rows are schema-checked, geocoded and quality-reviewed by the data custodian.
landing.how.analyse.title: Analyse
landing.how.analyse.text: The Enterprise Spatial Analytics Engine computes gap scores, service radii and suitability surfaces on a 3 km deficit model — thousands of cells, nightly.
landing.how.act.title: Act
landing.how.act.text: District Collector approves proposals and issues directives. Departments execute with geo-tagged field evidence — every step audited and SLA-tracked.
landing.how.inform.title: Inform
landing.how.inform.text: Citizens discover facilities, report issues and track resolution to a closed loop — a single source of truth for the entire district.
landing.portals.title: Four portals, one government platform
landing.portals.subtitle: Role-based workspaces designed for citizens, executives, line departments and field teams.
landing.portals.citizen.name: Citizen Portal
landing.portals.citizen.desc: Public services for every resident — map discovery, complaint registration and grievance tracking.
landing.portals.executive.name: Executive Command
landing.portals.executive.desc: District Collector & DM decision centre for cross-department oversight, approvals and tasking.
landing.portals.linedept.name: Line Department Portal
landing.portals.linedept.desc: Sector officers manage data, respond to directives and run operations from one workspace.
landing.portals.inspector.name: Field Inspector · Mobile
landing.portals.inspector.desc: Offline-first mobile experience for engineers capturing validated, geo-tagged field evidence.
landing.about.title: A Spatial Decision Support System for district governance
landing.about.subtitle: NDISP replaces manual, file-based coordination with a single GIS-driven platform — every administrative decision grounded in named spatial evidence.
landing.about.pr.gisFirst.title: GIS-First by Design
landing.about.pr.gisFirst.text: Every decision — siting, allocation, prioritisation — is grounded in named spatial evidence, not tables.
landing.about.pr.evidence.title: Evidence-Based Governance
landing.about.pr.evidence.text: Deficit scores and suitability surfaces computed once, shared across all departments.
landing.about.pr.interoperable.title: Interoperable & Open
landing.about.pr.interoperable.text: OGC WMS/WFS/WMTS aligned with PM GatiShakti, NSDI and Bhuvan national registries.
landing.about.pr.nationalScale.title: Built to National Scale
landing.about.pr.nationalScale.text: A unified schema that scales from 2 pilot districts to 700+ without redesign.
landing.about.pr.multilingual.title: Multilingual
landing.about.pr.multilingual.text: English and Hindi at launch, with a framework ready for every regional language.
landing.about.pr.secure.title: Secure & Auditable
landing.about.pr.secure.text: Three-layer RBAC, immutable audit trail and OWASP ASVS Level 2 security posture.
landing.about.custody: Data custody per the district matrix — Civil Surgeon Office, PHED Division, District Education Office, Tourism Office and BREDA.
landing.cta.title: Ready to experience NDISP?
landing.cta.subtitle: Explore any portal instantly with our role-based demo personas — Citizen, District Magistrate, Department Officer, Field Inspector and more.
landing.footer.tagline: A Spatial Decision Support System for district governance — connecting citizens, administration and line departments on a single GIS-driven platform.
